release_notes: Replaced unclear names: Moonlit Grotto is now Green Field, Moon Mart is Item Shop, and Journey is Travel.
Objectives are explicit: Catch captures creatures; Hatch uses A–D lanes and an egg; Evolve upgrades a caught creature; Travel is Travel Sling → Center Hole → blue portal → next field.
Either lower Travel Sling now lights Travel. Progress persists through other modes and stock balls instead of being silently erased.
Improved launch strength, flipper reach, loop entrances, sling kicks, saver relaunches, Shop switching, portal placement, and route telemetry.
Confirmed physical access to all four lanes, all three bumpers, both slings, both loops, spinner, Center Hole, creature, and Item Shop using only Space/A/D/W.

Luna completed four 130-second sessions: Travel reached Red Field in three, all routes were covered, and stickyFailures/missing were empty. Two additional reviewers independently accepted 4×150s and 4×180s audits.
The former 91-hit Red Field sling trap was removed by opening its return rail and adding distance-plus-time rearming. Luna’s maximum left-sling count fell to seven while broad circulation continued.
Validation passed: npm test, deterministic game tests, main-scene physics tests, browser/WebGL recording smoke test, export build, and git diff checks.
